tutorial1: Here you will learn how to be effective in the missionary field.
Start by using WASD to move around.
tutorial2: Great! Now you must learn how to share the gospel.
Point your mouse at whoever you want to share with, then press the left mouse button.
tutorial3: If you hit someone, they will think about it then decide if they like it.
If they like it, you can get thier information and start teaching them!
If they don't like it, it's best to leave them alone for a while.
tutorial4: That's all for now, you will continue to learn in the field.
Get in the plane to leave for your mission. God Bless!
